## Visible final answer

Result: a developed candidate, but the economic invention remains unestablished

I developed a pressure-matched converter, a restrained marine gas reservoir, a barrier-replacement operation, and executable cycle and lifetime-cost models. I have not established an installation meeting your economic targets.

The selected calculation produces a conditional 68.03% AC efficiency, but its central repeat-installed estimate is $12.37 million, or $123.71 per useful delivered kWh. Complete delivered cost is $742/MWh with $20/MWh charging electricity. Its remaining physical uncertainties also prevent treating that efficiency as qualified plant performance.

This is substantially less material-intensive than the preceding mineral-pore-bed construction. It does not establish a consequential advantage over the stronger alternatives.
